## Purpose

Describe the behavior this change adds or fixes, including the related public issue.

## Exact changes

List the changed files and any externally observable behavior. Document network, storage, permission, or compatibility implications.

## Validation

Provide test commands and results, device/Android versions when applicable, and any checks that cannot be run. Do not claim hardware or authenticated service testing that did not occur.

## Non-regression

- [ ] Existing features and UI/UX remain intact unless a specific change was approved.
- [ ] Existing tests have been preserved and relevant tests have been executed.
- [ ] No private development data, signing keys, tokens, cookies, or user records were committed.
- [ ] Redistribution rights for all newly added third-party content were reviewed.
- [ ] No paid GitHub Actions or chargeable CI workflows were introduced.

## Release impact

State whether this change requires a version bump, data migration, updated release notes, or a new signed APK.
